description: HP-83 is the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) situated in Jawalamukhi within the Kangra district of Himachal Pradesh. This office is responsible for vehicle registration, issuing driving licenses, and providing various transport-related services to the residents of the Jawalamukhi subdivision.
address: Sub Divisional Officer (Civil) Jawalamukhi, District Kangra, Himachal Pradesh
